rfc7208-tests/bytes-bug.reason: The upstream comment permits implementations without pySPF strict=2 to ignore this flag. The SPF result remains asserted.

rfc7208-tests/v-macro-ip6.reason: RFC 7208 section 7.3 requires IPv6 dot-format but does not mandate hex letter case. This implementation consistently uses lowercase. All other explanation bytes and the result are asserted.

test/default-modifier.reason: pySPF lax-mode default= extension is outside RFC 7208; rfc7208-tests/default-modifier-obsolete and default-modifier-obsolete2 assert that the modifier is ignored.

test/default-modifier-harsh.reason: pySPF strict-mode ambiguous result is outside the seven RFC 7208 results; default= behavior is covered by the RFC suite.
